title: Change the details of a UK establishment of an overseas company (OS CH01)
text:
This form should be used by a UK establishment of an overseas company to submit a return for change of details.

 The address must be the UK establishment address. This means the physical location in the UK where the overseas company is carrying out its business.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
